export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/parag-milk-foods-limited): "Total Shipments 765 Records detected ... Latest Cargo 2026-02-27"; row seen: "2026-02-27 | PARAG MILK FOODS LIMITED | 8 ELEVEN GHEE 5 LIT BUCKET X 20 LIT- LCS JAIGAON INJIGB, India | Phuntsholing, BHUTAN | 04059020 | BOL 1090977"; second row: "2026-02-24 | PARAG MILK FOODS LIMITED | 8 ELEVEN UHT MILK 1000 ML- LCS JAIGAON INJIGB, India | Phuntsholing, BHUTAN | 04015000 | BOL 9951023"; third row: "2026-02-23 | PARAG MILK FOODS LIMITED | FOOD CORPORATION OF BHUTAN | UHT MILK 1000 ML | Phuntsholing, BHUTAN | 04015000 | BOL 9914266". Counter vs rows: page claims 765 total shipments / 22 trading partners / 32 ports; only 5 shipment rows were visible on the free page (3 export rows to Bhutan, 1 import row from Netherlands, 1 export row to Bhutan) — the 765 figure is a platform counter, not independently verified. Destination observed: Bhutan (Phuntsholing, via LCS Jaigaon). HS codes actually shipped: 04059020 (ghee) and 04015000 (UHT milk) — NOT the declared 130232/170211.
domestic_evidence: Screener.in consolidated P&L (https://www.screener.in/company/PARAGMILK/consolidated/): "Sales + 1,443 1,645 1,731 1,955 2,396 2,438 1,842 2,072 2,893 3,139 3,432 3,818 4,143" (Rs crore, FY2015–FY2026) and "TTM 4,143"; quarterly: "Sep 2026 Sales 1,241". Listed entity BSE: 539889 / NSE: PARAGMILK, market cap Rs 4,549 Cr. Domestic sales are the overwhelming majority of this turnover (brands Gowardhan, Go, Avvatar; 35% cheese market share, 22% cow-ghee share per Screener summary). GSTIN-level turnover band not retrieved (not public in free sources) — null. GeM/CPPP tender records not retrieved (search tool was down during this run) — null.
note: Both legs of Rule 5 are satisfied with dated records, not claims: (a) export — dated customs/B-L rows to Bhutan on 2026-02-23/24/27 with BOL numbers 9914266, 9951023, 1090977; (b) domestic — audited consolidated turnover Rs 4,143 Cr TTM with quarterly sales of Rs 945–1,241 Cr, i.e. real domestic supply at scale. HS discrepancy: declared 130232 (locust bean/guar gum mucilages) and 170211 (lactose) do not match the actual shipped codes 04059020 (ghee) and 04015000 (UHT milk); per project rules this is not a rejection ground — company retained, HS to be corrected to the factual dairy codes (0401/0405), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Note the ImportKey page mixes import and export rows (e.g. 2026-02-21 import of packaging film from Trioworld Apeldoorn BV, Netherlands, HS 39202090, BOL 7673178) — only the India-origin rows count as exports. PAN AABCP0425G not independently verified in this run (registry check out of scope). Revenue: Rs 4,143 Cr TTM (consolidated, FY2026/TTM per Screener); export volume in value terms not public — null.
